long_biography.plain_text:
Jean-François Gobertier began as a wealth manager before founding GDP Vendôme in 1990. He built the company around the development, promotion and operation of medicalised residences for older people, integrating property and care services within one platform. At its defining combination with DomusVi, he held 99% of GDP Vendôme, giving him direct ownership of the platform he had built.

After selling his DVD/DomusVi interest, Gobertier redirected capital toward senior housing, real estate and hospitality. Villa Sully apartments extended his model from institutional care to supported living, while Maison Gobertier brought hotels and restaurants into a separate hospitality platform. He remains president of GDP Vendôme and continues to direct businesses spanning senior accommodation and property development.
